title: Satin Brass Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Allied Brass
description: This 18.75-inch wall mount shower basket keeps shampoo, soap, and bath essentials organized where you need them. Available in Satin Brass. Satin Brass combines warm golden tones. The oval combination design uses ventilated, heavy-gauge solid brass wires that will never rust, helping bottles drain and dry faster. Solid brass construction is built for daily shower use and long-term durability, with a concealed screw mounting system for a clean, finished look. Sized 18.75 in L x 2.25 in H x 4.13 in W (4.13 in projection). Includes basket and all installation hardware.  and backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
